name: fix-supported-targets-runners
body:
Source: the supported targets were 'darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64', with native CI for all four.

Inconsistency: GitHub-hosted native runners are not assured for every target on the private repo (feedback-36).

Resolution [with user]:
- Required targets are darwin/arm64 (Apple silicon) and windows/amd64.
- Intel macOS (darwin/amd64) is dropped and definitely unsupported.
- windows/arm64 is conditional: it is built, verified and released only if a GitHub-hosted native runner is available to the private repo. Otherwise it is unsupported, with no manual or self-hosted fallback.
- Runners: Apple silicon `macos-14`/`macos-latest`; `windows-latest`; `windows-11-arm` only if available.
- Acceptance changes from "four green jobs" to "one green native job per supported target".

Updated nodes: supported-platforms, single-binary, go-static-embedded-binary, cli-binary, target-platform, native-ci-verification, native-e2e-ci, release-workflow, release-pipeline, github-releases, homebrew-install (arm64 only), scoop-install (arm64 conditional), publish-release. The historical notes fix-single-binary-targets and distribution-decisions are marked superseded.

[autonomous]:
- The Homebrew formula refuses on Intel Macs with a clear "Apple silicon only" message.
- The manifests cover only the targets actually released.
